description: A grid that decides its own column count from the room it is given, rather than from a breakpoint anyone has to pick. Cells are as wide as they can be at or above a minimum, and the count falls as the room does, all the way to one. A row the items do not fill keeps its empty tracks, so a card on a short last page is as wide as a card on a full one. A grid given a height keeps its rows at their content height.

content.description: The cells, one per child. Nothing is wrapped and nothing is measured: a child is a grid item exactly as it was written, so a card, a chart or a definition list all lay out the same way.
